{{Quotation|game|Founded by exiles from [[Kryta]], this settlement is a common destination for political refugees. Those who find themselves "on the outs" with the current ruling faction in [[Lion's Arch]] come here to hide from the political upheaval rampant within the Krytan state. As a result, the haven's inhabitants are a combination of expatriates, agents, spies, and refugees.}}

In [[Tarnished Haven]] you will find [[Shing Jea Sherman]], an NPC that will shout a quote relating to a random title of any player standing near him.

==Getting there==
Starting in the town [[Rata Sum]], head through the southern exit into [[Magus Stones]]. Follow the eastern edge to the portal to [[Alcazia Tangle]] in the southeast corner and head through. Proceed to the southeastern corner of this area to reach Tarnished Haven.

==Notes==
*Upon approaching the henchmen, [[Mhenlo]] starts to show off his dancing skills in front of the other henchmen, who will encourage him. He does not [[dance]] like a [[Monk]] however, he dances like a [[Ranger]].
*The entrance to Alcazia Tangle via the northern [[portal]] is glitched: It is possible to leave Tarnished Haven by walking on the ledge of the way that leads to the portal, without actually going through the portal.
*Tarnished Haven, [[Sifhalla]], [[Piken Square (pre-Searing)]], [[Brauer Academy]], [[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard]], [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh (outpost)|Grand Court of Sebelkeh]], [[The Mouth of Torment]], and [[Yahnur Market]] are the only outposts with two exits leading to the same zone.
